function: Learned two-sided beam alignment (Tx and Rx beamforming vectors) from ping-pong pilots without channel estimation; port activation is a non-learned greedy rule (pp. 1, 6-9).
system: Point-to-point TDD MIMO fluid antenna: 1D arrays, 32 ports per side with 16 active, 0.1 wavelength spacing, 5 GHz carrier; single user; no RIS (pp. 3, 10-11).
method: Online: feed-forward Tx/Rx networks updated by SGD on beam gain during pilots, no pretraining; offline: GRU-based networks trained unsupervised with beam-gain loss on perfect-CSI samples (pp. 7-9).
data_channel: Own simulator: fluid-antenna spatial-coupling channel with i.i.d. CN(0,1) entries after Bessel-correlation matrices; 30,000 samples split 70/20/10 for training, validation, testing (pp. 4, 11).
test_conditions: Offline net trained at SNR 0 dB on 70% of 30,000 samples; online net has no pretraining; tests sweep SNR and activated ports N (pp. 11-13).
baselines: Non-learned: SVD with perfect CSI (upper bound), random port selection, full-size fixed-position array, power method. Learned: none; only own online vs offline variants compared (p. 11).
metrics: Throughput (bps/Hz) versus rounds, SNR and activated ports; beam alignment success rate with throughput-loss threshold; energy efficiency (pp. 11-13).
complexity: Big-O expressions for online learning, O(JL(M o^1 + ...)), and for offline-learning implementation, O(ZL(H(H+M) + ...)); no FLOPs or measured runtime (pp. 8-9).
q1_support: p. 11: "The entries of channel matrix are randomly generated according to CN (0, 1) [7]". Not met: custom spatial-coupling Rayleigh-type simulator (p. 4); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, QuaDRiGa or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 11: "Training of the offline-learning method is conducted at SNR = 0 dB". Not met: tests only sweep SNR and activated ports N on the same channel model and 32-port arrays; the online method has no pretraining.
q3_support: p. 11: "is a conventional method that adopts power iterations to obtain the top singular vectors of the channel matrix". Not met: non-learned baselines exist (power method, SVD, random ports, full-size array) but no earlier learned method is compared; online and offline schemes are both proposed.
q4_support: p. 8: "Using the algorithmic rules of big-O and assuming the NNs at transceivers are identical". Met: big-O complexity is derived for online learning (p. 8) and for the offline-learning implementation stage (p. 9).
q5_support: p. 11: "A total number of 30, 000 samples are generated with 70%, 20%, and 10% allocated for training, validation, and testing". Not met: data come from the authors' own simulator and no code or data link or DOI is given.
notes: Included as area 3: the learned networks output the Tx and Rx beamforming vectors (pp. 7-9), while port activation is a non-learned greedy rule (p. 9). Fluid-antenna ports are not a RIS, so ris is 0. Complexity (q4) is stated in big-O only. p. 11 says "The training process is carried out based on the test set", probably a typo since the split is 70/20/10; the SNR and port sweeps (Figs. 5-9) do not count for q2.
